messages:
maya (AE): Peregrine POC blocked: they won't sign off until we confirm BYOK KMS workflow and <2x latency SLO at 95th percentile. Also need committed throughput pricing to justify dedicated pool. CTO/infra waiting.

raj (SE): On it. Quick Q: what's their traffic shape? bursts or steady?

maya (AE): Bursty. ~300 rps spikes lasting ~4s every ~30s. Avg ~15 rps. Typical token len ~512.

raj (SE): Ok — viable pattern. Suggest Dedicated + burst capacity + prefix caching. Will test quantized model too. Draft routing policy:
```
route_policy:
  primary: dedicated-us-west
  fallback: hosted-small
  batching:
    max_tokens: 2048
    max_batch_delay_ms: 6
```

sophia (PM): Timeline? Need to tell customer when we can show measured 95th p95.

deploy-bot: available_capacity_check: us-west dedicated pool: 16 GPUs free for immediate allocation.

raj (SE): We'll need customer's allowlist / peering for 52.34.12.1/32 and their egress firewall rules. Also plan: q4_k_m quantized variant to reduce cost — but we'll show both perf profiles.

alice (Privacy): For BYOK we need KMS attestation + HSM info + key rotation cadence. Legal expects SOC2 artifact. I can prepare a template for the security answers.

maya (AE): They sent a security questionnaire (page 7 is KMS section). Uploaded as: https://redwood.internal/sqs/attachments/PRG-POC-sq.pdf

ev an (VP Sales): @maya loop me into the exec bridge if they ask for reserved commit. We can propose a 3-month pilot with a small commit discount to unblock.

raj (SE): Also configuring automatic fallback rule so we gracefully degrade to hosted-smaller model under capacity pressure. Will demo failover latency numbers.

ciso-bot: action: create JIRA RED-5432 -> "Peregrine BYOK + KMS flow diagram" assigned to alice.

maya (AE): Scheduled internal prep + customer bridge tomorrow 10:30 PT. Raj, can you demo failover + perf reproduction script?

raj (SE): Yup — will prepare perf graphs and a repro script:
`python perf_run.py --rps 300 --duration 4 --tokens 512`

alice (Privacy): I'll post the SQ answer template + list of artifacts (SOC2, KMS attestation, key rotation policy) by EOD.

ev an (VP Sales): Thanks. Goal: docs + draft pricing term before the exec bridge. I'll join the call. :thumbsup:
